197: static struct wifi_command_slot *wifi_command_alloc(void)
198: {
199:   unsigned int i;
200: 
201:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_WIFI_CMD_SLOTS; i++)
202:     {
203:       uint32_t *pattern = (uint32_t *)g_wifi.command[i].bytes;
204: 
205:       if (!g_wifi.command[i].owned &&
206:           !g_wifi.command[i].transport_pending &&
207:           *pattern == BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE)
208:         {
209:           g_wifi.command[i].owned = true;
210:           *pattern = BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_BUSY;
211:           return &g_wifi.command[i];
212:         }
213:     }
214: 
215:   return NULL;

218: static void wifi_command_reap(void)
219: {
220:   unsigned int i;
221: 
222:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_WIFI_CMD_SLOTS; i++)
223:     {
224:       uint32_t pattern = *(uint32_t *)g_wifi.command[i].bytes;
225: 
226:       if (g_wifi.command[i].owned &&
227:           !g_wifi.command[i].transport_pending &&
228:           pattern == BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE)
229:         {
230:           g_wifi.command[i].owned = false;
231:         }
232:     }

235: static void wifi_command_transport_complete(
236:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack, int result, void *arg)
237: {
238:   struct wifi_command_slot *slot = arg;
239:   bool wake = false;
240:   irqstate_t flags;
241: 
242:   (void)ack;
243:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
244:   if (slot->transport_pending)
245:     {
246:       slot->transport_pending = false;
247:       if (result == -EREMOTEIO && slot->owned)
248:         {
249:           *(uint32_t *)slot->bytes = BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE;
250:           slot->owned = false;
251:           if (g_wifi.waiting_id ==
252:                 slot->command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET &&
253:               g_wifi.waiting_sequence == slot->sequence)
254:             {
255:               g_wifi.command_result = -EREMOTEIO;
256:               g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
257:               wake = true;
258:             }
259:         }
260:     }
261:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
262: 
263:   if (wake)
264:     {
265:       nxsem_post(&g_wifi.command_sem);
266:     }
267: }

269: static int wifi_command(uint16_t command, const void *payload,
270:                          uint16_t payload_length, void *result,
271:                          uint16_t result_size, uint16_t *result_length)
272: {
273:   struct wifi_command_slot *slot;
274:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *cpdu;
275:   struct bk7258_wifi_msg_hdr *header;
276:   uint16_t sequence;
277:   int ret;
278: 
279:   if (payload_length > BK7258_WIFI_CMD_SLOT_SIZE - sizeof(uint32_t) -
280:                        sizeof(*cpdu) - sizeof(*header))
281:     {
282:       return -E2BIG;
283:     }
284: 
285:   if (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
286:     {
287:       return -ENOLINK;
288:     }
289: 
290:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.command_lock);
291:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
292:   wifi_command_reap();
293:   slot = wifi_command_alloc();
294:   if (slot == NULL)
295:     {
296:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
297:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.command_lock);
298:       return -ENOMEM;
299:     }
300: 
301:   cpdu = (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)(slot->bytes + sizeof(uint32_t));
302:   header = (struct bk7258_wifi_msg_hdr *)(cpdu + 1);
303:   sequence = ++g_wifi.next_sequence;
304:   memset(cpdu, 0, sizeof(*cpdu) + sizeof(*header) + payload_length);
305:   cpdu->length = sizeof(*cpdu) + sizeof(*header) + payload_length;
306:   header->cmd_id = command;
307:   header->cmd_sn = sequence;
308:   header->length = payload_length;
309:   slot->command = command;
310:   slot->sequence = sequence;
311:   slot->generation = bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation();
312:   slot->transport_pending = true;
313:   if (payload != NULL && payload_length != 0)
314:     {
315:       memcpy(header + 1, payload, payload_length);
316:     }
317: 
318:   while (nxsem_trywait(&g_wifi.command_sem) == OK)
319:     {
320:     }
321: 
322:   {
323:     irqstate_t flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
324: 
325:     g_wifi.waiting_id = command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET;
326:     g_wifi.waiting_sequence = sequence;
327:     g_wifi.command_result = -ETIMEDOUT;
328:     g_wifi.command_length = 0;
329:     rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
330:   }
331:   ret = wifi_send_node(BK7258_WIFI_CMD_TX_CHANNEL, 0,
332:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu,
333:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu, 1,
334:                        wifi_command_transport_complete, slot);
335:   if (ret < 0)
336:     {
337:       *(uint32_t *)slot->bytes = BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE;
338:       slot->owned = false;
339:       slot->transport_pending = false;
340:       {
341:         irqstate_t flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
342: 
343:         if (g_wifi.waiting_id == command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET &&
344:             g_wifi.waiting_sequence == sequence)
345:           {
346:             g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
347:           }
348:         rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
349:       }
350:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
351:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.command_lock);
352:       return ret;
353:     }
354:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
355: 
356:   ret = nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_wifi.command_sem,
357:                                        WIFI_COMMAND_TIMEOUT);
358:   {
359:     irqstate_t flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
360: 
361:     if (g_wifi.waiting_id == command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET &&
362:         g_wifi.waiting_sequence == sequence)
363:       {
364:         g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
365:       }
366:     if (ret >= 0)
367:       {
368:         ret = g_wifi.command_result;
369:       }
370:     rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
371:   }
372: 
373:   if (ret >= 0 && result != NULL && result_size != 0)
374:     {
375:       uint16_t copy = g_wifi.command_length < result_size ?
376:                       g_wifi.command_length : result_size;
377:       memcpy(result, g_wifi.command_data, copy);
378:     }
379:   if (ret >= 0 && result_length != NULL)
380:     {
381:       *result_length = g_wifi.command_length;
382:     }
383: 
384:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
385:   wifi_command_reap();
386:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
387:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.command_lock);
388:   return ret;
389: }

440: static bool wifi_sync_reset_generation(void)
441: {
442:   struct wifi_pending_node nodes[WIFI_NODE_QUEUE];
443:   uint32_t generation = bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation();
444:   bool wake_command = false;
445:   unsigned int kept = 0;
446:   unsigned int i;
447:   irqstate_t flags;
448: 
449:   if (generation == g_wifi.reset_generation)
450:     {
451:       return false;
452:     }
453: 
454:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
455:   if (g_wifi.waiting_id != 0)
456:     {
457:       g_wifi.command_result = -ECONNRESET;
458:       g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
459:       wake_command = true;
460:     }
461: 
462:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
463:   if (wake_command)
464:     {
465:       nxsem_post(&g_wifi.command_sem);
466:     }
467: 
468:   wifi_set_carrier(false);
469:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.scan_lock);
470:   wifi_scan_cache_clear();
471:   g_wifi.scan_running = false;
472:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.scan_lock);
473: 
474:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
475:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
476:   generation = bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation();
477: 
478:   /* A peer generation change proves the old CP can no longer reference AP
479:    * command slots.  TX slots remain quarantined because DMA completion is
480:    * not proven by a CP reset.
481:    */
482: 
483:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_WIFI_CMD_SLOTS; i++)
484:     {
485:       if (g_wifi.command[i].owned &&
486:           g_wifi.command[i].generation != generation)
487:         {
488:           *(uint32_t *)g_wifi.command[i].bytes =
489:             BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE;
490:           g_wifi.command[i].owned = false;
491:           g_wifi.command[i].transport_pending = false;
492:         }
493:     }
494:   g_wifi.reset_generation = generation;
495:   for (i = 0; i < g_wifi.node_count; i++)
496:     {
497:       unsigned int index = (g_wifi.node_head + i) % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
498: 
499:       if (g_wifi.nodes[index].generation == generation)
500:         {
501:           nodes[kept++] = g_wifi.nodes[index];
502:         }
503:     }
504:   memcpy(g_wifi.nodes, nodes, kept * sizeof(nodes[0]));
505:   g_wifi.node_head = 0;
506:   g_wifi.node_tail = kept % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
507:   g_wifi.node_count = kept;
508:   g_wifi.packet_head = 0;
509:   g_wifi.packet_tail = 0;
510:   g_wifi.packet_count = 0;
511:   for (i = 0; i < WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE; i++)
512:     {
513:       if (g_wifi.recycle[i].state != WIFI_RECYCLE_FREE &&
514:           g_wifi.recycle[i].generation != generation)
515:         {
516:           g_wifi.recycle[i].state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
517:         }
518:     }
519:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
520:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
521:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.work_sem);
522:   return true;
523: }

537: static int wifi_scan_cache_event(uint16_t command, const void *data,
538:                                  size_t length)
539: {
540:   struct iw_event event;
541: 
542:   memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
543:   event.cmd = command;
544:   event.len = offsetof(struct iw_event, u) + length;
545:   if (length > sizeof(event.u))

548:     }
549:   memcpy(&event.u, data, length);

553: static int wifi_scan_cache_build_record(
554:   const struct bk7258_wifi_scan_record *record)
555: {
556:   struct iw_event event;
557:   struct iw_quality quality;
558:   struct iw_freq frequency;
559:   uint16_t flags;
560:   size_t ssid_length;
561:   size_t padded_length;
562:   size_t event_length;
563:   int ret;
564: 
565:   memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
566:   event.cmd = SIOCGIWAP;
567:   event.len = IW_EV_LEN(ap_addr);
568:   event.u.ap_addr.sa_family = ARPHRD_ETHER;
569:   memcpy(event.u.ap_addr.sa_data, record->bssid, sizeof(record->bssid));
570:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_append(&event, event.len);
571:   if (ret < 0)
572:     {
573:       return ret;
574:     }
575: 
576:   ssid_length = strnlen(record->ssid, sizeof(record->ssid));
577:   padded_length = (ssid_length + 3u) & ~3u;
578:   memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
579:   event.cmd = SIOCGIWESSID;
580:   event.u.essid.flags = IW_ESSID_ON;
581:   event.u.essid.length = ssid_length;
582:   event.u.essid.pointer = (void *)(uintptr_t)sizeof(struct iw_point);
583:   event_length = offsetof(struct iw_event, u) + sizeof(struct iw_point) +
584:                  padded_length;
585:   event.len = event_length;
586:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_append(&event, offsetof(struct iw_event, u) +
587:                                sizeof(struct iw_point));
588:   if (ret < 0)
589:     {
590:       return ret;
591:     }
592:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_append(record->ssid, ssid_length);
593:   if (ret < 0)
594:     {
595:       return ret;
596:     }
597:   if (padded_length != ssid_length)
598:     {
599:       uint32_t padding = 0;
600:       ret = wifi_scan_cache_append(&padding, padded_length - ssid_length);
601:       if (ret < 0)
602:         {
603:           return ret;
604:         }
605:     }
606: 
607:   memset(&quality, 0, sizeof(quality));
608:   quality.level = (uint8_t)record->rssi;
609:   quality.updated = IW_QUAL_DBM;
610:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_event(IWEVQUAL, &quality, sizeof(quality));
611:   if (ret < 0)
612:     {
613:       return ret;
614:     }
615: 
616:   memset(&frequency, 0, sizeof(frequency));
617:   frequency.m = record->channel;
618:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_event(SIOCGIWFREQ, &frequency, sizeof(frequency));
619:   if (ret < 0)
620:     {
621:       return ret;
622:     }
623: 
624:   flags = record->security == 0 ? IW_ENCODE_DISABLED : IW_ENCODE_ENABLED;
625:   memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
626:   event.cmd = SIOCGIWENCODE;
627:   event.len = IW_EV_LEN(data);
628:   event.u.data.flags = flags;
629:   return wifi_scan_cache_append(&event, event.len);
630: }

632: static int wifi_scan_cache_fetch(void)
633: {
634:   struct bk7258_wifi_scan_page_request request;
635:   struct bk7258_wifi_scan_page_response response;
636:   uint16_t start = 0;
637:   uint16_t total = 0;
638:   uint16_t result_length;
639:   int ret;
640: 
641:   g_wifi.scan_cache = kmm_malloc(WIFI_SCAN_CACHE_LIMIT);
642:   if (g_wifi.scan_cache == NULL)
643:     {
644:       return -ENOMEM;
645:     }
646: 
647:   do
648:     {
649:       memset(&request, 0, sizeof(request));
650:       request.start = start;
651:       request.max_records = BK7258_WIFI_SCAN_PAGE_RECORDS;
652:       memset(&response, 0, sizeof(response));
653:       ret = wifi_command(BK7258_WIFI_CMD_OPENVELA_SCAN_PAGE,
654:                          &request, sizeof(request), &response,
655:                          sizeof(response), &result_length);
656:       if (ret < 0)
657:         {
658:           printf("wifi scan page transport failed: %d\n", ret);
659:           wifi_scan_cache_clear();
660:           return ret;
661:         }
662:       if (result_length != sizeof(response) || response.status != 0 ||
663:           response.page.start != start ||
664:           response.page.count > BK7258_WIFI_SCAN_PAGE_RECORDS ||
665:           response.page.reserved != 0 ||
666:           response.page.total < start ||
667:           response.page.count > response.page.total - start)
668:         {
669:           printf("wifi scan page invalid: status=%ld start=%u count=%u "
670:                  "total=%u length=%u\n",
671:                  (long)response.status, response.page.start,
672:                  response.page.count, response.page.total, result_length);
673:           wifi_scan_cache_clear();
674:           return response.status != 0 ? response.status : -EPROTO;
675:         }
676: 
677:       if (start == 0)
678:         {
679:           total = response.page.total;
680:         }
681:       else if (response.page.total != total)
682:         {
683:           wifi_scan_cache_clear();
684:           return -EPROTO;
685:         }
686: 
687:       for (uint8_t i = 0; i < response.page.count; i++)
688:         {
689:           ret = wifi_scan_cache_build_record(&response.page.records[i]);
690:           if (ret < 0)
691:             {
692:               wifi_scan_cache_clear();
693:               return ret;
694:             }
695:         }
696: 
697:       start += response.page.count;
698:       if (response.page.more != (start < total) ||
699:           (response.page.count == 0 && start < total))
700:         {
701:           wifi_scan_cache_clear();
702:           return -EPROTO;
703:         }
704:     }
705:   while (start < total);
706: 
707:   g_wifi.scan_cached = true;
708:   return OK;
709: }

723: static void wifi_handle_command(uint32_t cpdu_address,
724:                                 uint32_t generation)
725: {
726:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
727:   struct bk7258_wifi_event_hdr event;
728:   uint8_t data[sizeof(g_wifi.command_data)];
729:   uint32_t event_address;
730:   uint16_t length;
731:   uint16_t copied;
732:   irqstate_t flags;
733: 
734:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
735:   if (generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() ||
736:       !wifi_cp_pointer(cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu)))
737:     {
738:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
739:       return;
740:     }
741: 
742:   memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu));
743:   event_address = cpdu_address + sizeof(cpdu);
744:   if (cpdu.length < sizeof(cpdu) + sizeof(event) ||
745:       !wifi_cp_range(event_address, sizeof(event)))
746:     {
747:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
748:       return;
749:     }
750: 
751:   memcpy(&event, (const void *)(uintptr_t)event_address, sizeof(event));
752:   length = event.length;
753:   if (length > cpdu.length - sizeof(cpdu) - sizeof(event) ||
754:       !wifi_cp_range(event_address + WIFI_EVENT_DATA_OFFSET, length))
755:     {
756:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
757:       return;
758:     }
759: 
760:   copied = length < sizeof(data) ? length : sizeof(data);
761:   if (copied != 0)
762:     {
763:       memcpy(data, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(event_address +
764:                                               WIFI_EVENT_DATA_OFFSET),
765:              copied);
766:     }
767:   wifi_release_cp_command(cpdu_address);
768:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
769: 
770:   if (event.id >= BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET)
771:     {
772:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
773: 
774:       if (event.id == g_wifi.waiting_id &&
775:           event.sequence == g_wifi.waiting_sequence)
776:         {
777:           if (copied != 0)
778:             {
779:               memcpy(g_wifi.command_data, data, copied);
780:             }
781:           g_wifi.command_length = copied;
782:           g_wifi.command_result = OK;
783:           g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
784:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
785:           nxsem_post(&g_wifi.command_sem);
786:         }
787:       else
788:         {
789:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
790:         }
791:     }
792:   else if (event.id == BK7258_WIFI_EVT_IPV4_IND)
793:     {
794:       wifi_set_carrier(true);
795:     }
796:   else if (event.id == BK7258_WIFI_EVT_WIFI_EVENT_IND && copied >= 4)
797:     {
798:       uint16_t event_id;
799: 
800:       memcpy(&event_id, data, sizeof(event_id));
801:       if (event_id == BK7258_WIFI_EVENT_CONNECTED)
802:         {
803:           wifi_set_carrier(true);
804:         }
805:       else if (event_id == BK7258_WIFI_EVENT_DISCONNECTED)
806:         {
807:           wifi_set_carrier(false);
808:         }
809:     }
810:   else if (event.id == 3u)
811:     {
812:       wifi_set_carrier(false);
813:     }
814:   else if (event.id == 8u)
815:     {
816:       g_wifi.scan_running = false;
817:     }
818: 
819: }

821: static bool wifi_validate_command(uint32_t cpdu_address,
822:                                   uint32_t *next, uint32_t generation)
823: {
824:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
825:   struct bk7258_wifi_event_hdr event;
826:   uint32_t event_address;
827:   irqstate_t flags;
828: 
829:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
830:   if (generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() ||
831:       !wifi_cp_pointer(cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu)))
832:     {
833:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
834:       return false;
835:     }
836: 
837:   memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu));
838:   event_address = cpdu_address + sizeof(cpdu);
839:   if (cpdu.length < sizeof(cpdu) + sizeof(event) ||
840:       !wifi_cp_range(event_address, sizeof(event)))
841:     {
842:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
843:       return false;
844:     }
845: 
846:   memcpy(&event, (const void *)(uintptr_t)event_address, sizeof(event));
847:   if (event.length > cpdu.length - sizeof(cpdu) - sizeof(event) ||
848:       !wifi_cp_range(event_address + WIFI_EVENT_DATA_OFFSET, event.length))
849:     {
850:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
851:       return false;
852:     }
853: 
854:   *next = cpdu.next;
855:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
856:   return true;
857: }

859: static void wifi_handle_command_list(const struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node *node,
860:                                      uint32_t generation)
861: {
862:   uint32_t addresses[BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST];
863:   uint32_t address = node->head;
864:   unsigned int count;
865: 
866:   if (node->channel != 0 || node->num == 0 ||
867:       node->num > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
868:     {
869:       return;
870:     }
871: 
872:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
873:     {
874:       uint32_t next;
875:       unsigned int previous;
876: 
877:       if (!wifi_validate_command(address, &next, generation))
878:         {
879:           return;
880:         }
881:       for (previous = 0; previous < count; previous++)
882:         {
883:           if (addresses[previous] == address)
884:             {
885:               return;
886:             }
887:         }
888:       if ((count + 1 == node->num) != (address == node->tail))
889:         {
890:           return;
891:         }
892: 
893:       addresses[count] = address;
894:       address = next;
895:     }
896: 
897:   if (address != 0)
898:     {
899:       return;
900:     }
901: 
902:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
903:     {
904:       if (generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
905:         {
906:           return;
907:         }
908: 
909:       wifi_handle_command(addresses[count], generation);
910:     }
911: }

995: static bool wifi_copy_rx_frame(uint32_t cpdu_address,
996:                                struct wifi_rx_packet *packet)
997: {
998:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
999:   struct bk7258_wifi_pbuf pbuf;
1000:   uint32_t pbuf_address;
1001: 
1002:   if (!wifi_cp_pointer(cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu)) ||
1003:       cpdu_address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START + sizeof(pbuf))
1004:     {
1005:       return false;
1006:     }
1007: 
1008:   memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu));
1009:   pbuf_address = cpdu_address - sizeof(pbuf);
1010:   if (!wifi_cp_pointer(pbuf_address, sizeof(pbuf)))
1011:     {
1012:       return false;
1013:     }
1014: 
1015:   memcpy(&pbuf, (const void *)(uintptr_t)pbuf_address, sizeof(pbuf));
1016:   if ((cpdu.flags & 1u) != 0 || pbuf.next != 0 || pbuf.len == 0 ||
1017:       pbuf.len > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_FRAME || pbuf.tot_len != pbuf.len ||
1018:       pbuf.ref == 0 || pbuf.ref == UINT8_MAX ||
1019:       !wifi_cp_pointer(pbuf.payload, pbuf.len))
1020:     {
1021:       return false;
1022:     }
1023: 
1024:   if (packet != NULL)
1025:     {
1026:       memcpy(packet->frame, (const void *)(uintptr_t)pbuf.payload, pbuf.len);
1027:       packet->length = pbuf.len;
1028:     }
1029:   return true;
1030: }

1032: static void wifi_recycle_append(struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node *node,
1033:                                 uint32_t cpdu_address)
1034: {
1035:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *cpdu =
1036:     (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)(uintptr_t)cpdu_address;
1037:   uint32_t pbuf_address;
1038:   struct bk7258_wifi_pbuf *pbuf;
1039: 
1040:   pbuf_address = cpdu_address - sizeof(*pbuf);
1041:   pbuf = (struct bk7258_wifi_pbuf *)(uintptr_t)pbuf_address;
1042: 
1043:   /* Match wdrv_txdata_sender(): CP drops one reference before pbuf_free(). */
1044: 
1045:   pbuf->ref++;
1046:   cpdu->flags |= 1u;
1047:   cpdu->next = 0;
1048:   if (node->tail != 0)
1049:     {
1050:       ((struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)(uintptr_t)node->tail)->next =
1051:         cpdu_address;
1052:     }
1053:   else
1054:     {
1055:       node->head = cpdu_address;
1056:     }
1057: 
1058:   node->tail = cpdu_address;
1059:   node->num++;
1060: }

1062: static void wifi_recycle_complete(
1063:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack, int result, void *arg)
1064: {
1065:   struct wifi_recycle_entry *entry = arg;
1066:   irqstate_t flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1067: 
1068:   (void)ack;
1069:   if (entry->state == WIFI_RECYCLE_SENDING)
1070:     {
1071:       if (result == OK || entry->generation !=
1072:           bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
1073:         {
1074:           entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1075:         }
1076:       else
1077:         {
1078:           entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUED;
1079:         }
1080:     }
1081: 
1082:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1083:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.work_sem);

1086: static void wifi_flush_recycle(void)
1087: {
1088:   struct wifi_recycle_entry *entry;
1089:   irqstate_t flags;
1090:   int ret;
1091: 
1092:   for (;;)
1093:     {
1094:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1095:       if (g_wifi.recycle_count == 0)
1096:         {
1097:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1098:           return;
1099:         }
1100: 
1101:       entry = &g_wifi.recycle[g_wifi.recycle_head];
1102:       if (entry->generation != g_wifi.reset_generation)
1103:         {
1104:           entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1105:         }
1106: 
1107:       if (entry->state == WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD)
1108:         {
1109:           memset(entry, 0, sizeof(*entry));
1110:           g_wifi.recycle_head = (g_wifi.recycle_head + 1) %
1111:                                 WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE;
1112:           g_wifi.recycle_count--;
1113:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1114:           bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
1115:           continue;
1116:         }
1117: 
1118:       if (entry->state != WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUED ||
1119:           !bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
1120:         {
1121:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1122:           return;
1123:         }
1124: 
1125:       entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_SENDING;
1126:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1127:       ret = wifi_send_node_async(BK7258_WIFI_DATA_TX_CHANNEL, &entry->node,
1128:                                  wifi_recycle_complete, entry);
1129:       if (ret < 0)
1130:         {
1131:           flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1132:           if (entry->state == WIFI_RECYCLE_SENDING)
1133:             {
1134:               entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUED;
1135:             }
1136:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1137:         }
1138: 
1139:       return;
1140:     }
1141: }

1143: static void wifi_handle_data(const struct wifi_pending_node *pending,
1144:                              struct wifi_net_notifications *notifications)
1145: {
1146:   const struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node *node = &pending->node;
1147:   uint32_t addresses[BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST];
1148:   bool cp_owned[BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST];
1149:   struct wifi_recycle_entry *recycle;
1150:   uint32_t address = node->head;
1151:   uint8_t packet_added = 0;
1152:   unsigned int count;
1153:   irqstate_t flags;
1154: 
1155:   if (!pending->recycle_reserved || node->channel != 2 ||
1156:       node->num == 0 || node->num > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
1157:     {
1158:       return;
1159:     }
1160: 
1161:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1162:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1163:   recycle = &g_wifi.recycle[pending->recycle_index];
1164:   if (pending->generation != g_wifi.reset_generation ||
1165:       pending->generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
1166:     {
1167:       recycle->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1168:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1169:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1170:       return;
1171:     }
1172:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1173: 
1174:   /* First pass validates the complete list without changing either core's
1175:    * ownership.  A malformed list is left untouched.
1176:    */
1177: 
1178:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1179:     {
1180:       struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
1181:       struct wifi_tx_slot *tx;
1182:       uint32_t next;
1183:       unsigned int previous;
1184: 
1185:       if (address == 0)
1186:         {
1187:           goto invalid;
1188:         }
1189: 
1190:       for (previous = 0; previous < count; previous++)
1191:         {
1192:           if (addresses[previous] == address)
1193:             {
1194:               goto invalid;
1195:             }
1196:         }
1197: 
1198:       if ((count + 1 == node->num) != (address == node->tail))
1199:         {
1200:           goto invalid;
1201:         }
1202: 
1203:       addresses[count] = address;
1204:       tx = wifi_tx_slot(address);
1205:       if (tx != NULL)
1206:         {
1207:           struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *ap_cpdu =
1208:             (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)tx->headroom;
1209: 
1210:           if (!tx->active || (ap_cpdu->flags & 1u) == 0)
1211:             {
1212:               goto invalid;
1213:             }
1214: 
1215:           cp_owned[count] = false;
1216:           next = ap_cpdu->next;
1217:         }
1218:       else
1219:         {
1220:           flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1221:           if (pending->generation !=
1222:                 bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() ||
1223:               !wifi_cp_pointer(address, sizeof(cpdu)) ||
1224:               !wifi_copy_rx_frame(address, NULL))
1225:             {
1226:               rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1227:               goto invalid;
1228:             }
1229: 
1230:           memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address, sizeof(cpdu));
1231:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1232:           cp_owned[count] = true;
1233:           next = cpdu.next;
1234:         }
1235: 
1236:       address = next;
1237:     }
1238: 
1239:   if (address != 0)
1240:     {
1241:       goto invalid;
1242:     }
1243: 
1244:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1245:     {
1246:       if (cp_owned[count] &&
1247:           g_wifi.packet_count + packet_added < WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE)
1248:         {
1249:           unsigned int index = (g_wifi.packet_tail + packet_added) %
1250:                                WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE;
1251: 
1252:           flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1253:           if (pending->generation ==
1254:                 bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() &&
1255:               wifi_copy_rx_frame(addresses[count], &g_wifi.packets[index]))
1256:             {
1257:               packet_added++;
1258:             }
1259:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1260:         }
1261:     }
1262: 
1263:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1264:   if (pending->generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
1265:     {
1266:       recycle->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1267:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1268:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1269:       return;
1270:     }
1271: 
1272:   memset(&recycle->node, 0, sizeof(recycle->node));
1273:   recycle->node.channel = 2;
1274:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1275:     {
1276:       if (cp_owned[count] &&
1277:           recycle->node.num < BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
1278:         {
1279:           wifi_recycle_append(&recycle->node, addresses[count]);
1280:         }
1281:     }
1282: 
1283:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
1284:   recycle->state = recycle->node.num == 0 ? WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD :
1285:                                             WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUED;
1286:   g_wifi.packet_tail = (g_wifi.packet_tail + packet_added) %
1287:                        WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE;
1288:   g_wifi.packet_count += packet_added;
1289: 
1290:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1291:     {
1292:       if (!cp_owned[count])
1293:         {
1294:           struct wifi_tx_slot *tx = wifi_tx_slot(addresses[count]);
1295: 
1296:           notifications->tx_packets[notifications->tx_count++] = tx->packet;
1297:           tx->packet = NULL;
1298:           tx->active = false;
1299:           tx->transport_rejected = false;
1300:         }
1301:     }
1302:   if (packet_added != 0)
1303:     {
1304:       notifications->rxready = true;
1305:     }
1306:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1307:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1308:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.work_sem);
1309:   return;
1310: 
1311: invalid:
1312:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1313:   recycle->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1314:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1315:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1316: }

1319: static int wifi_mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
1320:                            uint8_t *ack_flags, void *arg)
1321: {
1322:   struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node node;
1323:   struct wifi_pending_node *pending;
1324:   irqstate_t flags;
1325: 
1326:   (void)ack_flags;
1327:   (void)arg;
1328:   memcpy(&node, message, sizeof(node));
1329:   if (node.num == 0 || node.num > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
1330:     {
1331:       return -EINVAL;
1332:     }
1333: 
1334:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1335:   if (g_wifi.node_count == WIFI_NODE_QUEUE ||
1336:       (node.channel == 2 &&
1337:        g_wifi.recycle_count == WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE))
1338:     {
1339:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1340:       return -EAGAIN;

177: 	bool "BK7258 internal analog audio (AUD)"
178: 	default n
179: 	select AUDIO
180: 	help

182: 		board the differential AUDLP/AUDLN pair feeds an HT6872 class-D
183: 		amplifier whose CTRL (mute) pin is GPIO50, and there is no I2S codec.
184: 		Asks CP1 for the AUDP power domain and the AUD module clock over the
185: 		PWC mailbox channel.
186: 
187: config BK7258_AUDIO_CAPTURE
188: 	bool "BK7258 audio capture (MIC1 + AEC reference)"
189: 	default n
190: 	depends on BK7258_AUDIO
191: 	help
192: 		Enable the ADC path. MIC1 (MICP1/MICN1) is the electret microphone.
193: 		When BK7258_AUDIO_AEC_REFERENCE is also set, MIC2 (MICP2/MICN2) is
194: 		enabled as well and carries the post-amplifier speaker feedback, so
195: 		captured frames are L/R interleaved with L = voice and R = echo
196: 		reference.
197: 
198: config BK7258_AUDIO_AEC_REFERENCE
199: 	bool "Capture the MIC2 hardware echo reference"
200: 	default n
201: 	depends on BK7258_AUDIO_CAPTURE
202: 	help
203: 		The schematic taps HT6872 OUT+/OUT- through R84/R83 (39K) and
204: 		C61/C60 (1uF) into MIC2P/MIC2N so that AEC can have a hardware echo
205: 		reference, and ana_reg27 does have a full micen field for MIC2.
206: 
207: 		This defaults to n because the reference cannot actually be read on
208: 		BK7258: measured on hardware, the ADC delivers a single channel and
209: 		the upper half of every AUD_ADC_FIFO_PORT word stays zero. With a
210: 		tone audibly playing and MIC1 picking it up acoustically (RMS rising
211: 		from 25.7 to 36.4), MIC2 still returned exactly zero across 15872
212: 		samples. That matches the vendor HAL, where sys_hal_aud_mic2_en()
213: 		and sys_hal_aud_dacr_en() are both explicit "//not support" stubs
214: 		for this SoC: the register fields exist, the datapath does not.
215: 
216: 		Enabling this only costs half of every capture buffer to zeros. Use
217: 		a software AEC reference instead -- feed aec_proc() the same PCM
218: 		that was queued to the DAC, which is cleaner anyway (no analog
219: 		noise, no divider tolerance) and needs only a fixed delay
220: 		compensation for the DAC and amplifier.
221: 
222: config BK7258_AUDIO_SAMPLERATE
223: 	int "Default audio sample rate"
224: 	default 16000
225: 	depends on BK7258_AUDIO
226: 	help
227: 		Used when the application does not configure a rate explicitly. Only
228: 		8000, 16000 and 32000 are currently reachable: the driver runs the
229: 		audio block from the 26 MHz crystal, and the 44100/48000 families
230: 		additionally require the APLL calibration sequence, which has not
231: 		been ported yet.
232: 
233: config BK7258_AUDIO_PA_MUTE_GPIO
234: 	int "External amplifier mute GPIO"
235: 	default 50
236: 	depends on BK7258_AUDIO
237: 	help
238: 		BK7258 GPIO driving net MUTE, which reaches the HT6872 CTRL pin
239: 		through R70 (1K). R71 (10K) pulls it low, so the amplifier is muted
240: 		until software drives this pin high. Per the board schematic
241: 		(AIDK_AI玩具开发板_原理图.pdf) MUTE is P50.
242: 
243: config BK7258_AUDIO_PA_ON_DELAY_MS
244: 	int "Delay between DAC enable and amplifier un-mute"
245: 	default 20
246: 	depends on BK7258_AUDIO
247: 	help
248: 		Mirrors onboard_speaker_stream's pa_on_delay: the DAC is started,
249: 		this delay elapses, then the amplifier is un-muted. Keeps the
250: 		amplifier off while the analog output settles so there is no pop.
251: 
252: config BK7258_AUDIO_PA_OFF_DELAY_MS
253: 	int "Delay between DAC mute and amplifier shutdown"
254: 	default 10
255: 	depends on BK7258_AUDIO
256: 	help
257: 		Mirrors onboard_speaker_stream's pa_off_delay. Note the vendor's
258: 		header comment and its code disagree on where this delay sits; the
259: 		code order (mute, delay, amplifier off, DAC teardown) is the one that
260: 		actually suppresses the pop and is what this driver implements.
261: 
262: config BK7258_JPEG_ENC
263: 	bool "BK7258 V4L2 M2M JPEG encoder (software)"
264: 	default n
265: 	depends on VIDEO && DRIVERS_VIDEO
266: 	select LIB_JPEG_TURBO
267: 	select BK7258_PSRAM
268: 	select SCHED_HPWORK
269: 	help
270: 		Register a V4L2 M2M codec that takes raw YUV on the OUTPUT queue and
271: 		produces JPEG on the CAPTURE queue.
272: 
273: 		This is a software encoder built on libjpeg-turbo. The chip's hardware
274: 		JPEG block is fed by the DVP camera interface and cannot read pixels
275: 		from memory, so it cannot back a memory-to-memory codec; that block
276: 		belongs to the capture driver instead.
277: 
278: 		Buffers are allocated from PSRAM, since one 640x480 frame exceeds the
279: 		AP's entire malloc heap.
280: 
281: if BK7258_JPEG_ENC
282: 
283: config BK7258_JPEG_ENC_DEV_PATH
284: 	string "Device node"
285: 	default "/dev/video1"
286: 	help
287: 		Kept off /dev/video0 so the camera capture driver can own that node.
288: 
289: config BK7258_JPEG_ENC_QUALITY
290: 	int "Default JPEG quality (1-100)"
291: 	default 80
292: 	range 1 100
293: 	help
294: 		Applications can override this at runtime with
295: 		V4L2_CID_JPEG_COMPRESSION_QUALITY.
296: 
297: endif
298: 
299: endif

500: static bk_err_t cif_handle_openvela_scan_page(struct bk_msg_hdr *msg)
501: {
502:     const struct openvela_scan_page_request *req =
503:         (const struct openvela_scan_page_request *)(msg + 1);
504:     struct openvela_scan_page_response response = {0};
505:     uint16_t available;
506:     uint16_t count;
507:     bk_err_t ret;
508:     bool last_page = false;
509: 
510:     if (msg->len != sizeof(*req)) {
511:         response.status = BK_ERR_PARAM;
512:         return cif_bk_cmd_confirm(msg, (uint8_t *)&response,
513:                                   sizeof(response));
514:     }
515: 
516:     response.page.start = req->start;
517:     if (req->max_records == 0 ||
518:         req->max_records > OPENVELA_SCAN_PAGE_RECORDS) {
519:         response.status = BK_ERR_PARAM;
520:         return cif_bk_cmd_confirm(msg, (uint8_t *)&response,
521:                                   sizeof(response));
522:     }
523: 
524:     if (req->start == 0)
525:     {
526:         cif_openvela_scan_result_clear();
527:         response.status = bk_wifi_scan_get_result(&s_openvela_scan_result);
528:         s_openvela_scan_result_valid = response.status == BK_OK;
529:     }
530:     else if (!s_openvela_scan_result_valid)
531:     {
532:         response.status = BK_ERR_STATE;
533:     }
534: 
535:     if (response.status == BK_OK) {
536:         if (s_openvela_scan_result.ap_num < 0 ||
537:             s_openvela_scan_result.ap_num > UINT16_MAX ||
538:             (s_openvela_scan_result.ap_num > 0 &&
539:              s_openvela_scan_result.aps == NULL) ||
540:             req->start > s_openvela_scan_result.ap_num) {
541:             response.status = BK_ERR_PARAM;
542:         } else {
543:             response.page.total = (uint16_t)s_openvela_scan_result.ap_num;
544:             available = response.page.total - req->start;
545:             count = available < req->max_records ? available :
546:                     req->max_records;
547:             response.page.count = (uint8_t)count;
548:             response.page.more = req->start + count < response.page.total;
549:             last_page = !response.page.more;
550: 
551:             for (uint16_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
552:                 const wifi_scan_ap_info_t *ap =
553:                     &s_openvela_scan_result.aps[req->start + i];
554:                 struct openvela_scan_record *record =
555:                     &response.page.records[i];
556: 
557:                 os_memcpy(record->ssid, ap->ssid, sizeof(record->ssid));
558:                 record->ssid[sizeof(record->ssid) - 1] = '\0';
559:                 os_memcpy(record->bssid, ap->bssid, sizeof(record->bssid));
560:                 record->rssi = (int8_t)ap->rssi;
561:                 record->channel = ap->channel;
562:                 record->security = (uint8_t)ap->security;
563:             }
564:         }
565:     }
566: 
567:     ret = cif_bk_cmd_confirm(msg, (uint8_t *)&response, sizeof(response));
568:     if (response.status != BK_OK || last_page)
569:     {
570:         cif_openvela_scan_result_clear();
571:     }
572: 
573:     return ret;
574: }

46: /*
47:  * Coexistence netif wire id (2-bit co_hdr.vif_idx). Roles are NOT pinned to a
48:  * fixed LMAC VIF index any more (P2P GO/GC float on vif0/vif1 so the MCC
49:  * channel scheduler can handle them). We therefore key the wire id off the
50:  * (netif type, p2p) role instead of the LMAC index:
51:  *
52:  *   wire 0 = infra STA   (STA-type, !p2p) -> host g_mlan
53:  *   wire 1 = SoftAP      (AP-type,  !p2p) -> host g_uap
54:  *   wire 2 = P2P GO      (AP-type,   p2p) -> host g_p2p_go
55:  *   wire 3 = P2P GC      (STA-type,  p2p) -> host g_p2p_gc
56:  *
57:  * The TX path is symmetric: host tags the wire id, CP maps it back to the
58:  * current LMAC VIF index via cif_wire_to_lmac_vif() (no longer identity).
59:  */
60: static uint8_t cif_vif_to_netif_wire(void *vif)
61: {
62:     netif_if_t t = wifi_netif_vif_to_netif_type(vif);
63:     bool p2p = cif_vif_is_p2p(vif);
64: 
65:     if ((t == NETIF_IF_AP) && p2p)
66:         return 2;
67:     if ((t == NETIF_IF_STA) && p2p)
68:         return 3;
69: 
70:     return (uint8_t)t;
71: }
72: 
73: /*
74:  * Reverse of cif_vif_to_netif_wire(): map a host wire id back to the LMAC VIF
75:  * index currently held by that role. Since GO/GC float on vif0/vif1, the old
76:  * identity mapping (wire==index) no longer holds, so look the role up in the
77:  * active VIF table. Falls back to the wire id if no active match is found.
78:  */
79: static uint8_t cif_wire_to_lmac_vif(uint8_t wire)
80: {
81:     netif_if_t want_type;
82:     bool want_p2p;
83: 
84:     switch (wire)
85:     {
86:         case 0: want_type = NETIF_IF_STA; want_p2p = false; break;
87:         case 1: want_type = NETIF_IF_AP;  want_p2p = false; break;
88:         case 2: want_type = NETIF_IF_AP;  want_p2p = true;  break;
89:         case 3: want_type = NETIF_IF_STA; want_p2p = true;  break;
90:         default: return wire;
91:     }
92: 
93:     for (void *vif = mac_vif_mgmt_first_vif(); vif != NULL;
94:          vif = mac_vif_mgmt_next_vif(vif))
95:     {
96:         if ((wifi_netif_vif_to_netif_type(vif) == want_type) &&
97:             (cif_vif_is_p2p(vif) == want_p2p))
98:             return wifi_netif_vif_to_vifid(vif);
99:     }
100: 
101:     return wire;
102: }

204: /****************************************************************************
205:  * Name: beken_wlan_send

207:  * Description:

210:  * Input Parameters:
211:  *   dev - Reference to the NuttX driver state structure
212:  *   pkt - The packets to transmit

219: static int beken_wlan_send(struct netdev_lowerhalf_s *dev, netpkt_t *pkt)
220: {
221:   static uint8_t tx_buf[2048];
222:   unsigned int len  = netpkt_getdatalen(dev, pkt);
223:   int rtn = 0;
224: 
225:   if (netpkt_is_fragmented(pkt))
226:     {
227:       netpkt_copyout(dev, tx_buf, pkt, len, 0);
228:       rtn = bk_wifi_send_tx_eth(tx_buf, len);
229:     }
230:   else
231:     {
232:       rtn = bk_wifi_send_tx_eth(netpkt_getdata(dev, pkt), len);
233:     }
234:   if (rtn > 0)
235:     {
236:       netpkt_free(dev, pkt, NETPKT_TX);
237:       return OK;
238:     }
239:   else
240:     {
241:       return -ENOMEM;
242:     }
243: }

254:         CIF_IRQ_ENABLE(int_level);
255:     }

258:     {
259:         return BK_OK;

261:     else
262:     {

270:     if(((first != NULL)&&(last!= NULL))&&(num == 0)) BK_ASSERT(0);
271: 
272:     if(first == NULL) goto ERR_EXIT;
273: 
274:     CIF_LOGV("%s,%d,p:0x%x,p:0x%x,num:%d\n",__func__,__LINE__,(struct pbuf*)first-1,(struct pbuf*)last-1,num);

21: # BK7258 OpenVela AP Wi-Fi 移植实施与验证方案
22: 
23: > 文档状态：2026-08-05 实施基线。OpenVela AP Wi-Fi 前端、NuttX `wlan0`、Mailbox CMD/DATA transport、STA 控制面、分页扫描、国家码、direct-push Ethernet 数据面以及最终固件构建已经完成。本文原先固定的“完全不修改 CP”结论已被实际源码证伪：当前 CP 会消费 DHCP/DNS/ARP，且不会向 AP 上报普通 STA connected event，因此必须对 CP 的 `controller_if` 和 VNET 分流做最小兼容扩展。射频、RWNX、WPA、MAC/PHY、校准和原 Mailbox channel ABI 保持不变。当前状态是离线编译和打包完成，不等同于实板扫描、关联、DHCP 和压力测试通过。
24: 
25: ## 1. 目标和固定结论
26: 
27: ### 1.1 移植目标
28: 
29: 在物理 CPU1 单核运行的 OpenVela AP 上实现 Wi-Fi STA 基础能力，同时保持以下内容原样：
30: 
31: - CPU0/CP 的 FreeRTOS、Wi-Fi controller、RWNX、WPA 和射频运行环境。
32: - CP 侧 Wi-Fi RWNX、UMAC/LMAC、MAC/PHY、RF、校准和共存逻辑。
33: - CP 侧 `controller_if`、`cif_ipc` 和原厂 Mailbox logical-channel wire ABI。
34: - bootloader、分区、CP 启动 AP 和 AP heartbeat/PWC 契约。
35: 
36: OpenVela AP 新增：
37: 
38: - 与原厂 `MB_CHNL_WIFI_CMD`、`MB_CHNL_WIFI_DATA` 兼容的 logical channel。
39: - 原厂 Wi-Fi command/event 协议兼容层。
40: - AP/CP 共享 Wi-Fi buffer 的地址校验、生命周期和 cache 处理。
41: - NuttX `netdev_lowerhalf` Wi-Fi 网卡 `wlan0`。
42: - NuttX wireless handlers，用于配置 SSID、密码、国家码、扫描、连接和断开。
43: - Wi-Fi transport、控制面和数据面的统计、超时与复位恢复。
44: - CP 侧 `CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_AP_IPV4` 透明 IPv4/ARP 分流和 STA link event。
45: - 不含远端 pointer 的 OpenVela scan-page/country 扩展 command。
46: 
47: ### 1.2 固定架构
48: 
49: ```text
50: CPU1/OpenVela AP，单核
51:   ├─ OpenVela application/socket
52:   ├─ NuttX IPv4/IPv6/TCP/UDP/DHCP/DNS
53:   ├─ BK7258 wlan0 netdev lower-half
54:   ├─ Wi-Fi control proxy
55:   └─ Wi-Fi IPC transport
56:           │
57:           │ AP→CP CMD/DATA 0x14/0x15
58:           │ CP→AP CMD/DATA 0x44/0x45
59:           │ MBOX0 + 共享 SRAM pointer/list
60:           ▼
61: CPU0/Armino CP，保留 controller，增加最小 VNET 兼容扩展
62:   ├─ controller_if/cif
63:   ├─ Wi-Fi command/event handler
64:   ├─ RWNX/FHOST/UMAC/LMAC
65:   ├─ WPA/关联控制
66:   └─ Wi-Fi MAC/PHY/RF
67: ```
68: 
69: 本方案中：
70: 
71: - CPU0 是 CP，不是 OpenVela AP。
72: - CPU1 是当前 OpenVela AP primary，也是唯一启用的 AP CPU。
73: - CPU2 保持当前单核 bring-up 状态，不参与 Wi-Fi ISR、worker 或共享 buffer 管理。
74: - CP 是 Wi-Fi radio/controller 的唯一所有者。
75: - NuttX 是 AP 网络协议栈的所有者。
76: - 第一版采用 copy 接入 NuttX `netpkt_t`，不追求 NuttX packet 与 CP pbuf 零拷贝。
77: 
78: ### 1.3 本轮明确不采用的方案
79: 
80: - 不修改 CP 的 RWNX、WPA、MAC/PHY/RF，不增加新 descriptor ring。
81: - 不把 CP Wi-Fi/RWNX 静态库链接进 OpenVela AP。
82: - 不让 OpenVela AP直接访问 Wi-Fi MAC/PHY/RF 寄存器。
83: - 不在 AP 内同时运行 Armino lwIP 和 NuttX 网络栈。
84: - 不通过 socket RPC 把全部 socket 操作代理到 CP。
85: - 不改变原厂 `MB_CHNL_WIFI_CMD`、`MB_CHNL_WIFI_DATA` 编号和既有 command ID；仅新增 OpenVela 专用 `0x20d..0x20f`。
86: - 不在第一阶段启用 SoftAP、P2P、monitor、raw link、CSI、FTM 或零拷贝。
87: - 不在第一阶段启用 CPU2 SMP。

414: ### 4.2 logical channel 扩展
415: 
416: 第一阶段将当前固定实现改成通用表：
417: 
418: ```c
419: struct bk7258_logical_channel
420: {
421:   uint8_t tx_id;
422:   uint8_t rx_id;
423:   bool opened;
424:   bool pending;
425:   mb_rx_callback_t rx;
426:   mb_tx_complete_t tx_complete;
427:   void *arg;
428:   struct mb_message tx_message;
429: };
430: ```
431: 
432: 至少注册：
433: 
434: ```text
435: HW_CTRL  0x10/0x40
436: PWC      0x12/0x42
437: WIFI_CMD AP TX/RX 0x14/0x44
438: WIFI_DATA AP TX/RX 0x15/0x45
439: UART0    0x19/0x49
440: ```
441: 
442: 实现语义必须与原厂一致：
443: 
444: - channel 值越小，物理调度优先级越高。
445: - 每个 logical command 都写入递增 `tx_seq`。
446: - transport ACK 必须匹配 logical channel 和 sequence。
447: - 无 handler 的合法通道返回 `CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL`。
448: - TX completion 只在匹配 ACK 后调用。
449: - timeout/reset 对 active transaction 回报失败，不能静默清 busy。
450: 
451: ### 4.3 Wi-Fi command transport
452: 
453: AP command 路径：
454: 
455: ```text
456: wireless_ops/ioctl
457:   -> bk7258_wifi_control_request()
458:   -> 分配 command buffer
459:   -> 填写 cmd_id/cmd_sn/payload
460:   -> cpdu_t header
461:   -> ipc_chnl_node_t(head=tail, num=1, channel=TX_BK_CMD_DATA)
462:   -> MB_CHNL_WIFI_CMD 0x14
463:   -> transport ACK
464:   -> CP command confirmation 0x44
465:   -> 按 cmd_id + sequence 唤醒等待者
466: ```
467: 
468: 必须区分：
469: 
470: - transport ACK：CP 已接管 `ipc_chnl_node_t`。
471: - command confirmation：CP 已执行业务命令并返回结果。
472: 
473: 控制请求使用 NuttX mutex + semaphore，要求：
474: 
475: - 每个请求有有界 timeout。
476: - timeout 后从 pending list 删除。
477: - CP/AP reset 时全部 pending request 返回 `-ECONNRESET`。
478: - 迟到 confirmation 只计数，不访问已释放 request。
479: - 不能在 Mailbox ISR 中阻塞。
480: 
481: ### 4.4 Wi-Fi TX 数据面
482: 
483: 由于 CP 不修改，CP 仍要求 Beken `pbuf/cpdu_t` 兼容布局。第一版在 AP 定义最小 wire-compatible TX allocation，不把 lwIP 协议栈带入 NuttX：
484: 
485: ```text
486: [wire pbuf-compatible metadata][cpdu_t][Ethernet frame]
487: ```
488: 
489: 是否必须完整复制原厂 `struct pbuf`，必须通过 CP `cif_handle_txdata()` 和实际编译配置确认。不能凭 `cpdu_t` 单独推断。正式编码前要固定：
490: 
491: - `sizeof(struct pbuf)`。
492: - payload 指针相对 pbuf/cpdu 的布局。
493: - `CONFIG_CONTROLLER_AP_BUFFER_COPY` 最终值。
494: - CP 是否修改 pbuf refcount、flags、next 和 payload。
495: - TX completion 是通过反向 `need_free` packet 还是 command confirmation。
496: 
497: 当前 `app_ab` direct-push 基线已经显示，CP 的 `cif_handle_txdata()` 会用 `head - sizeof(struct pbuf)` 还原并直接访问 AP 创建的 `struct pbuf`；TX 完成时 `cif_free_ap_txbuf()` 把同一对象的 `need_free` 置 1，再通过 CP→AP `WIFI_DATA 0x45` 返回。因此 W3 不是只兼容一个抽象的“pbuf-like metadata”，而是必须冻结并复现该最终构建所使用的完整 lwIP `struct pbuf` ABI，包括字段大小、顺序、对齐、payload 指针、refcount 和 `pbuf + 1 == cpdu` 布局。若无法证明 NuttX AP RAM 地址可被 CP 直接访问，或者无法安全复现该 ABI，则“不修改 CP”的 W1 数据面方案被阻断；不得继续靠猜测实现。
498: 
499: 依据：
500: 
501: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_wifi_dp.c:138-179`
502: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_mem_mgmt.c:8-24`
503: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi_driver/wdrv_tx.c:49-111`
504: 
505: TX 路径：
506: 
507: ```text
508: NuttX transmit(netpkt)
509:   -> 从 AP Wi-Fi TX pool 取对象
510:   -> netpkt_copyout() 到兼容 Ethernet payload
511:   -> 设置 cpdu.length/type/vif/need_free
512:   -> 保存 netpkt 和 shared object 的 pending 关系
513:   -> MB_CHNL_WIFI_DATA
514:   -> CP 接管并发往 Wi-Fi
515:   -> CP 返回 TX completion/free indication
516:   -> 释放 shared object 和 netpkt
517:   -> netdev_lower_txdone()
518: ```
519: 
520: `transmit()` 必须遵守：

**研究范围与结论**

未修改任何文件。实际开发目录是 `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing`；其规划文档也明确该目录才是正式移植代码位置，[BK7258_OPENVELA_WIFI_PORTING_PLAN.md](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/docs/plans/BK7258_OPENVELA_WIFI_PORTING_PLAN.md:3)。`/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp` 仅作为原厂参考工程，下文会明确标注其引用性质。

目前实现的是一张 `wlan0` 的 STA 控制面加 STA 数据面。CP 的协议和原厂实现具备 STA/SoftAP VIF 区分能力，但 OpenVela AP 端没有把该区分传入 TX，也没有在 RX 端解复用，因此当前端到端实现实际固定在 STA。

**1. 当前 STA 控制面调用链**

初始化路径：

```text
board bring-up
  -> bk7258_mailbox_wait_link_ready()
  -> bk7258_wifi_initialize()
  -> 注册 CMD RX 0x44 / DATA RX 0x45 回调
  -> 创建 bk-wifi worker
  -> BK_CMD_GET_MAC_ADDR / BK_CMD_GET_WLAN_STATUS
  -> netdev_lower_register(..., NET_LL_IEEE80211)
  -> NuttX wlan0
```

- 板级启动在 Mailbox link、heartbeat、PWC 就绪后调用 Wi-Fi 初始化：[bk7258_bringup.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/bk7258_bringup.c:141)、[bk7258_bringup.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/bk7258_bringup.c:175)。
- `bk7258_wifi_initialize()` 注册 CP 到 AP 的 command/data mailbox 逻辑通道 `0x44/0x45`，安装 link callback，并创建 `bk-wifi` worker：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1917)。
- 初始化同步取得 MAC 和 WLAN status，但 status 缓冲区只被填充、没有解析或用于恢复 carrier 状态：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1955)。
- lower-half 用 `NET_LL_IEEE80211` 注册，实际名称由 NuttX 命名为 `wlan0`：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1971)。

用户态 WAPI/ioctl 到 STA connect：

```text
SIOCSIWESSID, flags=IW_ESSID_ON
  -> netdev_upper_wireless_ioctl()
  -> wireless_ops.essid(set)
  -> wireless_ops.connect()
  -> wifi_connect()
  -> wifi_command(BK_CMD_CONNECT = 2)
  -> AP->CP CMD mailbox 0x14, IPC node channel=0
  -> CP cif_dnld_buffer()
  -> cif_main(), CIF_TASK_MSG_CMD
  -> cif_handle_bk_cmd()
  -> cif_handle_bk_cmd_connect_req()
  -> cif_sta_app_init()
  -> bk_wifi_sta_set_config()
  -> bk_wifi_sta_start()
```

- NuttX 对 `SIOCSIWESSID` 的语义是：先调用 `.essid()`，若 flag 是 `IW_ESSID_ON` 再调用 `.connect()`；并没有独立的 commit 路径：[netdev_upperhalf.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/net/netdev_upperhalf.c:1005)。
- 当前 `.connect` 把 AP 本地保存的 `ssid[33] + password[64]` 直接作为 `BK7258_WIFI_CMD_CONNECT` payload：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1583)。
- 通用 `wifi_command()` 分配共享 command slot，建立 `cmd_id/cmd_sn`，经 `0x14` 发送，并等待同序号 confirmation：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:269)。
- Wi-Fi CMD/DATA mailbox 编号分别为 AP→CP `0x14/0x15`、CP→AP `0x44/0x45`：[bk7258_wifi_ipc.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/hardware/bk7258_wifi_ipc.h:11)。
- CP 收到 command list 后将其投递为 `CIF_TASK_MSG_CMD`：[cif_main.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_main.c:122)。
- CP 的 `BK_CMD_CONNECT` handler 先发送 confirmation，之后运行 `cif_sta_app_init()`；后者调用 `bk_wifi_sta_set_config()` 与 `bk_wifi_sta_start()`：[cif_cntrl.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_cntrl.c:95)、[cif_cntrl.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_cntrl.c:206)。

STA 异步状态返回：

```text
WPA/CP 关联或获得 IPv4
  -> cif_bk_send_event()
  -> CP->AP CMD 0x44
  -> wifi_mailbox_rx()
  -> bk-wifi worker
  -> wifi_handle_command()
  -> wifi_set_carrier(true/false)
  -> netdev_lower_carrier_on/off()
```

- AP 端以 confirmation ID `command + 0x8000` 和 sequence 匹配同步返回；异步 event 由同一个 command RX 通道处理：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:723)。
- AP 端把 `BK_EVT_IPV4_IND=1` 直接作为 carrier up；同时识别封装在 `BK_EVT_WIFI_EVENT_IND=0x12` 中的 `CONNECTED=2` / `DISCONNECTED=4`：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:792)。
- 由于 CP 配置启用 `CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_AP_IPV4=y`，WPA 的 STA connect/disconnect 通知会以 `BK_EVT_WIFI_EVENT_IND` 送给 AP：[notify.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/wpa_supplicant-2.10/wpa_supplicant/notify.c:381)、[notify.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/wpa_supplicant-2.10/wpa_supplicant/notify.c:449)。
- `wifi_set_carrier()` 是当前唯一将 Wi-Fi 链路状态投射到 NuttX netdev 的机制：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:391)。

**当前 STA 数据面调用链**

TX：

```text
NuttX upper-half
  -> wifi_transmit()
  -> AP TX slot: [pbuf][708-byte headroom containing CPDU][Ethernet frame]
  -> CPDU type=TX_MSDU_DATA, vif_idx=0
  -> AP->CP DATA 0x15, IPC node channel=2
  -> CP cif_handle_txdata()
  -> cif_wire_to_lmac_vif(vif_idx)
  -> bmsg_tx_sender()
  -> CP->AP DATA 0x45 回传 need_free
  -> wifi_handle_data()
  -> netpkt_free(..., NETPKT_TX) + netdev_lower_txdone()
```

- `wifi_transmit()` 只在 `carrier` 与 mailbox ready 都成立时发送：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1462)。
- TX frame 被复制进固定 AP slot，构造 pbuf/CPDU，之后通过 `0x15`、IPC node channel `2` 发送：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1497)。
- CP 从 `head - sizeof(struct pbuf)` 恢复 pbuf，使用 CPDU 中的 `vif_idx` 查找当前 LMAC VIF，然后调用 `bmsg_tx_sender()`：[cif_wifi_dp.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_wifi_dp.c:138)。
- TX completion 不是 mailbox transport ACK；transport ACK 仅说明 CP 已接管 IPC node。真正 packet ownership 完成由 CP 回传 data CPDU，AP 识别为本地 TX slot 后释放 `netpkt` 并调用 `netdev_lower_txdone()`：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1289)、[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:956)。

RX：

```text
Wi-Fi RX at CP
  -> cif_rx_local_packet_check(p, vif, dst_idx)
  -> cif_vif_to_netif_wire(vif)
  -> CP->AP DATA 0x45, channel=2
  -> wifi_mailbox_rx()
  -> bk-wifi worker / wifi_handle_data()
  -> validate + copy Ethernet frame to g_wifi.packets[4]
  -> recycle CP pbuf through AP->CP DATA 0x15
  -> netdev_lower_rxready()
  -> wifi_receive() -> netpkt_copyin()
```

- AP 端 RX worker 对 CP buffer 做地址、长度、链表循环和 pbuf reference 校验，然后复制到 4 项 `g_wifi.packets` 环形队列：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1143)。
- CP pbuf 归还使用单独 recycle queue，并以 `need_free` 和 pbuf refcount 遵循 CP 原始所有权协议：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1032)。
- `wifi_receive()` 从唯一的 `g_wifi.packets` 队列消费，未携带角色或 VIF 信息：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1532)。

**2. 数据包 API 是否接口无关，是否硬编码 STA**

结论：**底层 CP 协议是角色/VIF 感知的；当前 OpenVela AP driver 的数据包 API 不是接口无关，TX 实际硬编码 STA，RX 也没有接口解复用。**

证据如下：

- CP `common_header` 明确含 2-bit `vif_idx`；同一字节还包含 `need_free`、`is_buf_bank`、`special_type`：[cif_main.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_main.h:262)。
- CP 对 wire VIF 的当前定义不是 LMAC index 固定映射，而是角色映射：`0=infra STA`、`1=SoftAP`、`2=P2P GO`、`3=P2P GC`；收到 AP 数据时再反向找到实际 LMAC VIF：[cif_wifi_dp.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_wifi_dp.c:46)。
- AP 侧 wire ABI 虽保留 `pbuf.if_idx` 字段，但发送代码没有给它赋值；更关键的 CPDU bitfield 也没有 VIF setter：[bk7258_wifi_ipc.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/hardware/bk7258_wifi_ipc.h:99)。
- `wifi_transmit()` 对 CPDU 先 `memset()`，只写 `type_dst = 2u`，`flags` 保持 0。因此 `vif_idx` 位保持 0，即 CP 侧的 infra-STA wire role：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1497)。
- 原厂 AP `wdrv_txdata_sender()` 则显式写 `cpdu->co_hdr.vif_idx = vif_idx`，证明这一写入是协议需要而非可选字段：[wdrv_tx.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi_driver/wdrv_tx.c:49)。这是参考工程证据，不是当前正式目录文件。
- CP→AP RX 已填充 role wire ID：`cif_vif_to_netif_wire(vif)` 写入 `co_hdr.vif_idx`：[cif_wifi_dp.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_wifi_dp.c:542)。但 AP `wifi_handle_data()` 完全不读取它，所有收到的 packet 都进入唯一的 `g_wifi.packets`。

更关键的是，当前 CP 配置并未向 AP 提供完整 SoftAP Ethernet 数据面：

- 实际 CP config 启用 `CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_AP_IPV4=y`：[config](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config:5)。
- CP `cif_rx_local_packet_check()` 只在 `vif` 为普通 STA 时令 `ap_owns_ipv4=true`；SoftAP 和 P2P 均为 false：[cif_wifi_dp.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_wifi_dp.c:438)。
- 项目自身文档记录的结论一致：该配置只将基础设施 STA 的 ARP/IPv4 交给 AP，EAPOL、SoftAP、P2P 继续由 CP 处理：[BK7258_OPENVELA_WIFI_PORTING_PLAN.md](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/docs/plans/BK7258_OPENVELA_WIFI_PORTING_PLAN.md:307)。

所以，单纯补 `vif_idx=1` 可使 SoftAP TX 在 CP 正确选 AP VIF，但不能使 OpenVela 获得 SoftAP client 的完整 RX、ARP、DHCP、IPv4/IPv6 流量。

**3. AP 模式 `wireless_ops` 映射与底层 API**

当前 `wireless_ops` 表只对应 STA：`.connect/.disconnect` 是 STA command，`.mode/.auth` 只是保存到本地变量，其余很多能力为 `NULL`：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1860)。

建议以 `IW_MODE_MASTER` 作为 SoftAP 角色，配置阶段只改 AP-side pending config，`connect` 再原子提交。具体映射如下。

| `wireless_ops` | SoftAP 语义 | 可用 CP 传统 ABI | 应调用的 CP 底层 API |
|---|---|---|---|
| `connect` | 启动 configured SoftAP | `BK_CMD_START_AP=4`，payload `band + ssid[33] + pw[64] + channel + hidden` | 当前 handler 调 `demo_softap_app_init()` 或 hidden 版本；更稳妥的新固定宽度 command 应调用 `bk_wifi_ap_set_config()` 后 `bk_wifi_ap_start()` |
| `disconnect` | 停止 SoftAP | `BK_CMD_STOP_AP=6` | `bk_wifi_ap_stop()` |
| `essid` | AP SSID set/get | 当前 START_AP payload 可表达 set；没有 get ABI | 新 fixed-width `AP_GET_CONFIG` command 调 `bk_wifi_ap_get_config()`；现阶段 get 只能返回 AP 本地 pending/active cache |
| `passwd` | AP PSK set/get | 当前 START_AP payload 可表达 set | `wifi_ap_config_t.password`，通过 `bk_wifi_ap_set_config()`；get 不应返回明文，应报告不可读或仅本地 pending 值 |
| `mode` | 仅接受 `IW_MODE_MASTER`，get 返回 active/pending role | 无可靠 `CHANGE_AP_MODE=5` handler | 角色转换应由 AP driver 状态机实施，不应发送未实现的 command 5 |
| `auth` | 映射为 AP security，例如 WPA2-PSK、WPA3 SAE | 传统 START_AP 没有显式 security 字段 | `wifi_ap_config_t.security`，再 `bk_wifi_ap_set_config()`；必须增加 fixed-width ABI，不能传 CP 指针 |
| `freq` | AP channel set/get | START_AP 有 1-byte channel；另有 API ID `AP_SET_CHANNEL=0x324` | `bk_wifi_set_ap_channel()`；get 对应 `bk_wlan_ap_get_channel_config()`，需要新的值语义 response |
| `bssid` | set 不支持；get 返回 AP BSSID/MAC | 传统 `GET_MAC_ADDR` 返回 base MAC，非 AP role MAC | `bk_wifi_ap_get_mac()`，应新增固定 response；`SIOCSIWAP` 对 AP 应拒绝 |
| `country` | radio 全局国家码，不是 per-VIF | 已有 `0x20e/0x20f` | `bk_wifi_get_country()` / `bk_wifi_set_country()`，当前已可复用 |
| `scan` | SoftAP 运行中扫描可能切信道或破坏 client 服务 | STA scan command 可用但语义不安全 | AP active 时应返回 `-EBUSY` 或明确 CP 支持 MCC/ACS 后再实现 |
| `bitrate` | 当前无可靠 AP bit-rate ABI | 无 | 保持 `NULL` |
| `txpower` | 当前只有 country 中全局 `max_tx_power`，并非 per-AP txpower | 无直接 AP txpower command | 保持 `NULL`，避免伪成功 |
| `sensitivity` | 无已验证底层接口 | 无 | 保持 `NULL` |
| `range` | 报告受 country 和当前硬件限制的 2.4 GHz channel range | 可由本地静态能力生成 | 无需 CP command，但不应始终虚报 14 个 channel |

传统 AP control 的实际 CP 定义和执行路径：

- `BK_CMD_START_AP=4`、`BK_CMD_STOP_AP=6`：[cif_main.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_main.h:93)。
- `BK_CMD_START_AP` 的请求结构含 `band/ssid/pw/channel/hidden`：[cif_main.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_main.h:316)。
- CP start handler 对 `band==1` 明确拒绝 5 GHz；成功路径调 `demo_softap_app_init()` / `demo_softap_hidden_init()`，再发送 start event：[cif_cntrl.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_cntrl.c:362)。
- stop handler 调 `bk_wifi_ap_stop()` 并发 `BK_EVT_STOP_AP_IND`：[cif_cntrl.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_cntrl.c:430)。

CP 确实有较完整 API ID 集合，例如 `AP_SET_CONFIG=0x320`、`AP_START=0x321`、`AP_STOP=0x322`、`AP_SET_CHANNEL=0x324`、`AP_GET_STA_LIST=0x327`、`AP_GET_NETIF_IP4_CONFIG=0x329`：[cif_wifi_api.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_wifi_api.h:36)。但它的参数是 CP 可解引用指针，例如 `AP_SET_CONFIG` 将 `args[0]` 直接转换为 `wifi_ap_config_t *`：[cif_wifi_api.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_wifi_api.c:534)。因此不能从 OpenVela AP 直接调用这套 pointer ABI；应仿照现有 scan-page/country 扩展，定义固定宽度、无远端指针的 AP wire ABI。

作为底层 API 的字段依据，原厂 `wifi_ap_config_t` 有 `ssid/password/channel/security/hidden/acs/max_con`：[wifi_types.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/modules/wifi_types.h:541)。`bk_wifi_ap_set_config()` 负责 channel、SSID、PSK、安全类型、DHCP enable 与 AP configured bit：[wifi_v2.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_v2.c:3815)。

**4. 事件、MAC、ifup/down、状态变量的缺口**

事件缺口：

- CP 已有完整传统 SoftAP event：`START_AP=4`、`ASSOC_AP=5`、`DISASSOC_AP=6`、`STOP_AP=7`：[cif_main.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_main.h:137)。
- hostapd 在客户端关联/去关联时确实发送对应 event，数据是 station MAC：[notify.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/wpa_supplicant-2.10/wpa_supplicant/notify.c:641)。
- 当前 `wifi_handle_command()` 不处理 event `4/5/6/7`。它仅处理 STA IPv4、STA connected/disconnected、裸常量 event `3` 和 `8`：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:792)。
- 因此 AP start 成功后不会 carrier-on；AP stop 不会驱动 AP role state 清理；client join/leave 没有 client list、MAC cache、NuttX wireless event 或统计出口。
- scan complete 使用裸常量 `8u`，disconnect 使用裸常量 `3u`，应至少替换为协议命名常量并按 role 处理，避免 AP event ID 重叠时误解。

MAC 缺口：

- 当前只执行 `BK_CMD_GET_MAC_ADDR`，CP 实现取的是 `MAC_TYPE_BASE`：[cif_cntrl.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_cntrl.c:298)。
- AP 端只把这一 MAC 写到唯一 `g_wifi.lower.netdev.d_mac`：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1962)。
- 原厂前端初始化时分别取 `bk_wifi_sta_get_mac()` 和 `bk_wifi_ap_get_mac()`，并分别添加 netif：[wifi_api.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_api.c:236)。当前 OpenVela 无法证明 base MAC 等于 SoftAP BSSID/MAC。
- 双 netdev 必须有 role-specific MAC 获取 ABI；单网卡切 role 也必须决定是否更新 `d_mac`，不能静默沿用 STA/base MAC。

`ifup/ifdown` 缺口：

- 当前 `wifi_ifup()` 是纯 no-op：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1449)。
- `wifi_ifdown()` 只 carrier-off，不执行 `BK_CMD_DISCONNECT`、`BK_CMD_STOP_AP`、packet drain 或 role cleanup：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1455)。
- 所以 ifdown 后 CP 仍可能 STA connected/AP running，CP 也仍可能把 RX frame 送来；随后的 ifup 不会按真实 CP 状态重建 carrier。
- link/reset 只会关 carrier、打断同步 command、清 scan cache；不会可靠完成 in-flight TX。代码注释也明确 TX slot 会被 quarantine，因为无法证明 CP DMA completion：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:478)。若 CP 永不回 completion，相关 `netpkt` 与 tx quota 可能长期滞留。

状态模型缺口：

- `g_wifi.mode` 初始为 `IW_MODE_INFRA`，`.mode` setter 只改本地 `uint32_t`，不会启动/停止任何 CP role：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1723)。
- `.auth` 同样只是本地 `int32_t`，不影响 STA security，也没有 AP security 映射：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1738)。
- 当前 state 只有全局 `ssid/password/mode/auth/initialized/carrier/scan_running/scan_cached`：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:104)。缺少 `admin_up`、`configured_role`、`active_role`、`sta_associated`、`sta_has_ipv4`、`ap_started`、`ap_client_count`、`ap_channel`、`ap_security`、`ap_hidden`、`role MAC`、`last failure/reason`。
- `carrier` 被同时用作 STA association/IP、接口 admin 状态和 TX permit；对 AP 必须重新定义为“beaconing/SoftAP started”，不能由 client join/leave 翻转。
- `ssid/password/mode/auth/carrier` 没有统一的 role/config mutex；connect 构造 payload 时与 ioctl setter 可以并发。scan event 对 `scan_running` 的写入也不在 `scan_lock` 保护下：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:815)。

**5. 单网卡动态 STA/AP 或双网卡的建议**

**当前阶段建议：保留一张 NuttX 网卡，改为“互斥的动态 STA/AP role”，不要立刻注册第二张网卡。**

理由不是底层不支持双 VIF，而是当前 OpenVela 数据面和 CP 流量所有权尚不支持 SoftAP netdev：

- 当前 AP driver 只有一个 `struct netdev_lowerhalf_s lower`、一个 RX queue、一个 TX slot pool、一个 carrier 与一个 MAC：[bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:104)。
- TX 强制写 role 0，RX 不做 VIF demux，增加 `uap0` 只会让两个 netdev 争用同一个错误角色的数据面。
- CP 当前只把 infra-STA 的 ARP/IPv4 移给 AP；SoftAP 的 IP/DHCP/data 仍在 CP。因此即使立即注册第二张 NuttX `uap0`，它也不能成为可用 SoftAP Ethernet 接口。
- CP 本身运行 SoftAP IP 状态和 DHCP server：`uap_ip_start()` 配置 `g_uap` 并启动该侧服务：[net.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/lwip_intf_v2_1/lwip-2.1.2/port/net.c:801)。这与 NuttX `uap0` 同时作为 AP IP owner 会冲突。

单网卡动态 role 的边界应明确：

- 只允许 `IW_MODE_INFRA` 或 `IW_MODE_MASTER` 之一 active，切换必须先停旧 role、等待 CP event/confirmation、drain 或隔离旧 TX，再更新 active state 和 carrier。
- 这可先完成 AP 的配置、启动、停止、client event 和管理面，但**在 CP 尚未转发 SoftAP Ethernet 的前提下，不应把它宣称为 NuttX 托管的可用 SoftAP IP 数据面**。
- 若产品需求只是 CP 继续托管 SoftAP DHCP/IP、OpenVela 只管理 AP 生命周期，此架构足够，但应将 NuttX carrier/数据面语义限定清楚。

**最终若需求是 STA+SoftAP 并发，并且 NuttX 要拥有两个 L3/L2 接口，则应转为双网卡。** 原厂架构本身也是这个模型：

- 原厂 AP lwIP 常驻 `g_mlan`（STA）和 `g_uap`（SoftAP）两个 netif：[net.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/lwip_intf_v2_1/lwip-2.1.2/port/net.c:199)。
- 原厂初始化分别取 STA/AP MAC 并添加两张 netif：[wifi_api.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_api.c:255)。
- CP 已经存在 `wire 0/1` 角色路由，因此未来双 netdev 的正确实现是为每个 lower-half 记录固定 wire role，在 TX 填入它，在 RX 按 CPDU `vif_idx` 分派，而不是按物理 LMAC VIF index 硬编码。

双网卡的前置条件：

1. CP 修改或新增配置，使 SoftAP 的完整 Ethernet RX/TX ownership 可交给 AP，而不只是 STA ARP/IPv4。
2. 固定 SoftAP pbuf lifecycle、DHCP/ARP/DNS 的唯一 owner，避免 CP 与 NuttX 双栈同时答复。
3. 增加 pointer-free AP config/status/MAC/station-list ABI。
4. AP driver 变为 per-role state、per-role carrier、per-role MAC、per-role RX queue，且 TX 正确填写 wire role。
5. 定义 STA+AP 同信道、MCC、CSA、重连、AP restart 时的路由和 packet drain 规则。

因此，当前最合理的路线是：先把一张网卡的角色状态机和 AP control/event 补完整，保持 STA/AP 互斥；只有在 CP SoftAP 数据转发与 IP owner 迁移完成后，再提升为 `wlan0 + uap0` 的并发双网卡模型。
